d: Delightful countryside with a lovely hill in a façade, adorned with several little trees; and on one side the city's view, with a door that leads into the same. Archfanfano under a capricious throne. Two Pazzi, his ministers, at the table writing; and other Pazzi servants. All the other six Pazzi, men and women, are sitting, scattered across the hill under the little trees; and two Pazzi are standing at the foot of the hill, listening to what they say.
Sordidone sees gold on the ground.
Furious with the sword pressing some Pazzi; then Arcifanano with a nerbo of bove.
Madame Simplicina and sayings; then Madame Garbata.
Madame Gloriosa with the mirror in her hand and Malgovernment with the casket.

Strange salon, or other whimsical scene, with five iron cages. In one there is Glorious madam, in the second Sordidone, in the third madam Garbata, in the fourth Furibondo, and in the fifth Malgovernment. Other Crazy are watching and laughing at them.
Short campaign. Sordidone with the chest and a shovel, then Malgovernment.
Room with throne and three chairs. Archfanfano with Guards; then madam Gloriosa, Madame Garbata and Madame Simplicina.
Room. Sordidone, Malgovernment, Furibondo, Glorious Madame, Madame Garbata, Crazy Servants.
